messages:
amanda: Opening a quick follow-up thread from today’s all-hands re: the reliability incident. Full RCA here (internal): https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-04-10-backpressure-summary. Drop questions, clarification requests, and volunteers for the action items.

rachel: Thanks for posting. Two asks from leadership: 1) an executive-friendly 1-pager summarizing customer impact and next steps; 2) a clear owner list with target dates. Who can take those?

josh: I can do the 1-pager. Need sanitized impact numbers and confirmation on which customers were affected. @kelsey are those in the incident doc?

sree: I updated the RCA with the affected tenant IDs (sanitized) and the estimated error windows. Link above. I can own the technical runbook and rollback criteria. ETA for runbook: tomorrow EOD.

lina: Ops requests: add an automated alert for "consecutive_route_retries>5" and a dashboard tile for prefix-miss rate. I can add alert + tile by Friday AM and will include PagerDuty mapping.

amanda: For roadmap clarity: does this incident change our timeline for the lightweight cache optimizer slated for Q2? Leadership wants to know if we should re-prioritize.

sree: Short answer: the optimizer helps long-term; immediate mitigations (routing fallback + throttle tuning) will reduce near-term risk. We should keep the optimizer timeline but consider accelerating pre-release tests.

rachel: Noted. Leadership prefers we keep Q2 target but accelerate test coverage. Josh, include that note in the 1-pager.

josh: Will do. Also, can someone paste the minimal repro logs or command to reproduce locally for SE/support esc? Helps with quicker triage.

amanda: Repro snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-04-10T11:22:01Z router: upstream-reset route=us-east-1 retries=2
2026-04-10T11:22:01Z client: queued due to backpressure; prefix_hit=false
2026-04-10T11:22:02Z router: retry_policy=aggressive attempt=6
```

lina: Action owners summary I propose: (A) Exec 1-pager  josh (Tue EOD); (B) Technical runbook + rollback  sree (tomorrow EOD); (C) Alerts & dashboard  lina (Fri AM); (D) Postmortem doc edits + public customer summary  kelsey (pending security approval); (E) CI smoke test for prefix-miss pattern  eng-qa (assign after this thread).

rachel: Can we get a short note from security on whether the RCA link is safe to share with pilot customers? @amanda please coordinate.

amanda: Will ping security and update the RCA permission bits. Also will coordinate with kelsey on the customer-facing summary once approved.

product-bot: FYI: two customers on the pilot plan were flagged as potentially impacted  actions: product outreach recommended if we do a hotfix.

josh: One more ask from PM: if we choose the hotfix path, what's the expected customer-facing downtime or risk window? sree?

sree: If hotfix applied with conservative rollout and canary (10%), risk window is minimal, but we should expect a brief p95 latency increase for the first ramp. We should communicate that in the 1-pager.

amanda: Thanks all. Jay (sorry, I meant josh) will consolidate and post the all-hands follow-up doc when PRs, runbook link, and exec summary are ready. Reply here if you'd like tasks reassigned.

josh: I'll post the consolidated follow-up by tomorrow and tag owners. Thanks everyone.
__notes: Single-string Slack thread, messages in chronological order; metadata fields per agents.md.
